comment: Live planner canary question set testing AI Record Detail Coverage changes (2026-08-19). Exercises work_order_item planning grid vocabulary, job department scoping, customer orders, inventory receipts, AR aging, and fail-closed refusal boundaries.

principal_profile.construction: entity 1 = primary tenant; manifest hash = accepted current policy manifest

questions.q: How many units of products were planned on jobs this month?
questions.note: Tests product_units_used measure over work_order_item planning grid lines

questions.q: Count of jobs per department for jobs started during July 2026.
questions.note: Tests job.department_name grouping with July 2026 business period

questions.q: How many customer orders are currently open?
questions.note: Tests open customer orders count (NEW / IN_PROGRESS states)

questions.q: Give me the receivables aging buckets as of today.
questions.note: Tests ar_aging bucket set over due_date

questions.q: How many stock receipts were recorded this quarter?
How many finished jobs are currently unbilled?
What was our total invoiced revenue for July 2026?

questions.note: Bare metric with no period — must ask clarification rather than guessing invoiced vs ledger vs cash

questions.q: Which customer orders were completed on July 14th 2026?
questions.note: Job completion timestamp absent — must refuse honestly as unsupported

questions.q: What is the ordered quantity for job 24694?
questions.note: Raw ordered_qty is available only in jobs.show.v1 page context; no cross-record Business Query member exists yet
Changing specification JSON is not yet a typed queryable dimension

questions.q: Which jobs have more than 5,000 ordered pieces?
questions.note: ordered_qty is legacy free text and is not an aggregatable numeric Business Query member

questions.q: Show the specification details for job 24694.
questions.note: Full specification detail requires the Phase B typed detail read path; SQL must not scrape raw JSON

denied_probe.q: What is our company total ledger revenue?
denied_probe.note: Sales-only permissions asking for financial ledger revenue — must be Denied before DB execution
